newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil finds hydrocarbons near N.Sea Yme field.
newsitem.headline: Statoil finds hydrocarbons near N.Sea Yme field.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) has made a hydrocarbon discovery on the Beta-West prospect, 13 km southwest of the Yme field in the southern section of the North Sea, the Norwegian Oil Directorate (OD) said on Monday.
The OD said the discovery would be further drilled and produced from the Maersk Giant production rig located at the Yme development.
No production test was carried out at exploration well 9/2-7S, which was drilled to a depth of 3,370 metres below sea level.
Statoil is operator of licence 114 with a 65 percent stake, and is partnered by Saga Petroleum ASA with 25 percent and Deminex with 10 percent.
